summary_text: In May 2026, the user purchased dry pasta products on one observed date (2026-05-27). As this is a single observed order on one date, it does not establish a durable brand preference for Flipkart Supermart or a specific shape preference for fusilli or penne over other pasta types. It is unclear if this represents a routine pantry restock or a one-off meal preparation.
